notes: Statement: IATI 2021 senior day 2 task 1 (Hint), arena.olimpiici.com problem 1603 (PDF, Bulgarian, 2 pages; pinned in `statement`). Page 1's "Локално тестване" (local testing) section gives Lgrader's input format in prose (N and M, then A and B, then K and an optimal C), and page 2 has only the constraints, subtasks and scoring; neither page has an example input or interaction, so tests.toml has no inline case. Grader-only (genHint and solve in separate processes), stdio-adapted through interactor.py: round 1 gets the local grader's input (N M, A, B, K, an optimal C) and prints the hint bits, round 2 gets A, B and the hint and prints an LCS, checked for length K and for being common; one process serves both rounds, so state kept across them is not caught. The judge requires the full score, a hint of at most 639 bits (min((640 / (L + 1))^0.3, 1) = 1). No accepted submission exists (the four C++ ones crash), so orig.cpp sends no bits and solve finds an LCS by itself: Hirschberg's split with bit-parallel LCS rows, about 2 s at N = M = 200 000 for random values, A = B over 3 values, and two permutations. It matches gen.py's LCS length (Hunt-Szymanski, itself checked against the O(NM) DP) on 400 generated cases.
